# Metrum AI Router
> Open-source (Apache-2.0) LLM smart router. Selects a different upstream model
> per request from a deployment-owned, versioned policy, then records the
> decision as evidence. Includes gateway functions (single endpoint, provider
> keys, quotas, budgets, telemetry) in service of enforceable routing.

Category: LLM router. Comparable to RouteLLM, Not Diamond, Azure Model Router.
Distinct from pure gateways, which load-balance or failover but do not select
per request on measured quality and cost signals.

## Routing
- User code never runs inside the router process. The in-process TypeScript
  routing strategy (`strategy: script`) was removed in v5.0.0; migrate custom
  routing to a standalone policy service with `strategy: external`.
- [Learned Routing Policy](./docs/routing/learned-routing-policy)
- [Dynamic Score Routing](./docs/configuration/dynamic-score-routing)
- [Model Group Contracts](./docs/configuration/model-group-contracts)
- [External Routing Policy](./docs/configuration/external-routing-policy)
- [TypeScript Routing Migration](./docs/configuration/routing-typescript)
